# web_push_elixir v0.8.0 - Table of Contents

Simple web push for Elixir

## Modules

- [WebPushElixir](https://web-push-elixir.hexdocs.pm/WebPushElixir.md): Module to send web push notifications with an encrypted payload.

- [WebPushElixir.Application](https://web-push-elixir.hexdocs.pm/WebPushElixir.Application.md)

## Mix Tasks

- [mix generate.vapid.keys](https://web-push-elixir.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Generate.Vapid.Keys.md): The mix task: `mix help generate.vapid.keys`
